# Input Number

```tsx
import { InputNumber } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A number field with Minus and Plus buttons. Mirrors the Figma Input Number component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. Hover, Active and Filled follow the browser; Disabled, Read Only and Error come from props. Arrow Up / Down also step the value, within `min` and `max`.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<InputNumber {...args} icon={getLeadingIcon({ showIcon, icon })} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Number component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error. It shares the label, field, Focus ring and messages with Input Text; instead of Button Clear the field ends with Button Minus and Button Plus (ghost, 32px, 4px apart). Built on the Base UI NumberField, so Arrow Up / Down, min, max and step work too.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputNumberProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `className?` | `string` | Classes for the root, around the label, field and messages. |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Leading 20px icon. |
| `placeholder?` | `string` | Text shown while empty. |
| `decrementLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of Button Minus. |
| `incrementLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of Button Plus. |

## Rules

- Import `InputNumber` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
